mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4, which nifedipine inhibits, potentially increasing tolterodine levels; both drugs have anticholinergic and vasodilatory properties that may have additive effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, dizziness) and blood pressure changes; consider tolterodine dose reduction if adverse effects emerge.
